title: Wooden Trunk
summary: A 4 HP trunk that can be moved and stacked.

fields.Durability: 4 HP, about 22 lb. Resists Piercing and Necrotic, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning, and is immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Handling: Stack containers to gain height, which can affect damage when throwing objects down.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
